svg.title: Why did the lowest zero seem to predict the score?
svg.desc: Two plots use the same 201 rank-zero twists of 11a1 and identical scales. Comparing a total to its closest zero pair gives a strong upward trend. Subtracting that contribution from each total leaves a narrow band. The marked curve falls from 10.73 to 0.94 after removing 9.79. The initial scores are the scaled lower estimates used in the audit.
svg.text: Why the fit looked so good
Each dot is a curve. The same 201 curves
appear on the same scale in both plots.
